market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: Bottoms is the clear front-runner with strong name recognition and party backing, but primaries carry inherent risk (unexpected challengers, shifts in voter sentiment, campaign missteps). A 94% implied probability ignores the ~10–15% chance of an upset or a withdrawal, so the market overprices YES.
evidence_points: Bottoms has not formally announced, leaving room for other credible candidates to enter.
Georgia Democratic primaries have seen late surging candidates before (e.g., 2014 Carter).
National political winds or personal controversies could erode her lead.
Despite being the favorite, a 12% chance of defeat is more realistic than the market’s 6%.
sources_consulted: Recent news reports on potential 2026 Georgia governor candidates
Political risk assessments for down-ballot primaries
